title: identity-and-settings
objective: Story identity and settings homes: a pre-v2.1 chat migrates intact, a chat plays its pinned copy through library edits and deletion, a new chat inherits the install profile, and Restart is the only reset.

checks.goal: the example story carries an authored id, and the chat keys its state by it

steps.eval: const blob = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; if (blob.version !== 3) throw new Error(`expected blob version 3, got ${blob.version}`); if (!blob.stories['sun-ruins']?.pinnedStory) throw new Error('story was not pinned into the chat'); if (blob.selectedStoryId !== 'sun-ruins') throw new Error(`selection not keyed by id: ${blob.selectedStoryId}`); return { keys: Object.keys(blob.stories), playedVersion: blob.stories['sun-ruins'].playedVersion };

checks.goal: the memory profile is stored install-wide, never in the chat

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const global = rt.getGlobalSettings(); if (!global.extraction.profileId) throw new Error('profile did not land in the install settings'); const extras = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator.stories['sun-ruins'].extras; if (extras.extraction?.settings) throw new Error('chat still carries extraction settings'); if (extras.memory?.settings) throw new Error('chat still carries memory settings'); return { profileId: global.extraction.profileId, chatExtractionKeys: Object.keys(extras.extraction ?? {}) };

checks.goal: re-selecting the same story hydrates progress instead of wiping it

steps.send: I am standing at the board.

checks.goal: a library edit does not reach a chat that already pinned the story

steps.eval: const response = await fetch('/scripts/extensions/third-party/story-orchestrator/examples/sun-ruins/quest-for-the-sun-ruins.json'); const story = await response.json(); story.description = 'Edited in the library while a chat is playing.'; await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.importStory(JSON.stringify(story)); return globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().storyIdentity;

const snapshot = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); if (snapshot.storyDescription.startsWith('Edited in the library')) throw new Error('library edit leaked into the running chat'); return { description: snapshot.storyDescription.slice(0, 60), identity: snapshot.storyIdentity };

checks.goal: deleting the library record leaves the running chat playable from its pinned copy

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ok = await rt.removeStory('sun-ruins'); if (!ok) throw new Error('remove failed'); await rt.loadSelectedFromChat(); const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); if (snapshot.activeCheckpointId !== 'cp2') throw new Error(`chat lost its story after library delete: ${snapshot.activeCheckpointId}`); return { identity: snapshot.storyIdentity, library: snapshot.library.length };

checks.goal: a brand-new chat on a configured install plays immediately, with no per-chat setup

steps.eval: const response = await fetch('/scripts/extensions/third-party/story-orchestrator/examples/sun-ruins/quest-for-the-sun-ruins.json'); await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.importStory(await response.text()); return true;
await SillyTavern.getContext().executeSlashCommandsWithOptions('/newchat'); await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 2500)); return { chatId: SillyTavern.getContext().chatId };

const settings = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings; if (!settings.enabled || !settings.profileId) throw new Error(`fresh chat is not configured: ${JSON.stringify(settings)}`); return settings;

checks.goal: Restart is the only reset, and it re-pins the latest library version
a pre-v2.1 chat blob migrates to id-keyed state with the story pinned

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const hash = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().storyHash; const engineState = ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator.stories['sun-ruins'].engineState; ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator = { version: 2, selectedStoryHash: 'v2-legacyhash', stories: { 'v2-legacyhash': { storyHash: 'v2-legacyhash', storyTitle: 'Quest for the Sun Ruins', engineState, extras: { updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } } } }; await ctx.saveMetadata(); await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.loadSelectedFromChat(); const blob = ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; if (blob.version !== 3) throw new Error(`blob not migrated: version ${blob.version}`); if (blob.selectedStoryId !== 'sun-ruins') throw new Error(`legacy hash not rekeyed: ${blob.selectedStoryId}`); if (!blob.stories['sun-ruins'].pinnedStory) throw new Error('migration did not pin the story'); return { selectedStoryId: blob.selectedStoryId, keys: Object.keys(blob.stories) };

checks.prompt: Reading the settings panel, was it clear which settings apply to every chat and which only to this one?
checks.anchors: 1 = no idea · 3 = worked it out · 5 = obvious at a glance

checks.prompt: The memory-model self-test: did its result tell you something you could act on?
checks.anchors: 1 = meaningless · 3 = confirmed it works · 5 = told me exactly what this model can and cannot do
